test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct form of the given sentence.

He told her that he could not marry her then but he would surely do so the following year.

options.text: He said to her, “ He cannot marry you now but he will surely do so next year.”
He said to her, “ I cannot marry you now but I will surely do so next year.”
He said to her, “ I could not marry you then but I will surely do so next year.”
He said to her, “ I cannot marry her then but I will surely do so next year.”

solution:
The correct answer is option 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the direct form should convert the reported speech back to the original spoken words.
 
• The pronouns and tense should be adjusted to reflect what was originally said.
 
• The correct form is: **He said to her, “I cannot marry you now but I will surely do so next year.”**
 
 
• ​Format =** Reported verb + ,... "..." + Reported Speech**
 
 

Hence, the correct statement is **'*He said to her, “I cannot marry you now but I will surely do so next year.'***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When converting from indirect to direct speech, ensure you change the pronouns and tense appropriately.
 
• Keep the original meaning and context intact while making these adjustments.
